notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror is a dark, atmospheric psychological thriller where players step into the shoes of an amnesiac detective searching for the truth behind a series of mysterious disappearances. As they navigate a haunting world filled with twisted realities and unsettling secrets, they must solve puzzles, uncover hidden memories, and confront dangerous foes. With a gripping story, immersive environments, and a constantly shifting narrative, Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror offers a chilling journey into the fractured mind of a detective in pursuit of their own identity.

Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror delivers a gripping psychological horror experience, seamlessly blending exploration, puzzle-solving, stealth, and resource management.
